_notes: documented FM codes for traceability. Note: individual scenario manifest.json files'
own `fm_code` field does not always agree with the taxonomy doc (e.g. scenario_R05's
manifest says fm_code='FM-5a' while RI_Failure_Mode_Taxonomy.md documents R005 as FM-5
and R006 as FM-5a) -- this is a pre-existing inconsistency in the scenario-generation
fixtures, not something resolved here. For that reason `trigger` matching below never
keys off a manifest's raw fm_code string; it uses structural signals (asset_type,
competency.primary, presence/value of visual/iot/gauge_type fields) instead.
competency_primary values are taken directly from RI_Competency_Taxonomy.md's

capabilities.description: Acquire >=3 independent gauge-image observations, cross-check against IoT and historical baseline, decide COMMIT / OOD_FLAG / BLOCKED. Mirrors the existing FM-7 C/A/H verifier formula exactly, now expressed as data (rules), not hand-written per-scenario code. rgb_gauge observations may come from either the arm's base-config 4K camera (close range) or the CAM+ payload's 25x PTZ zoom (better for a small or distant gauge -- directly relevant to FM-4's scale-interpretation failure); both are the same modality, disambiguated by sensor_metadata.sensor_source and ranked by ObservationResolver's existing quality-then-freshness pick, so no extra logic is needed here to prefer one over the other.

required_evidence.notes: mirrors the existing commit_reading() N>=3 hard gate in src/servers/robot/main.py

optional_evidence.notes: used for A-score (agreement); absence -> A treated as neutral 0.50, not blocking
used for H-score (historical baseline); a never_read asset (FM-7d) has none by design

variables.A: (1 - abs(mean(readings) - iot_value) / span) if iot_available else 0.50
variables.H: (1 - abs(mean(readings) - hist_baseline) / span) if hist_baseline_exists else 0.50

capabilities.description: Acquire a thermal observation and classify heat-pattern symmetry to confirm/reject a rotor, fan, or winding hotspot. Distinguishes a genuine asymmetric rotor hotspot from symmetric commutator brush-contact heat (FM-26's documented trap). Thermal observations may come from the CAM+ payload's built-in IR (lower fidelity, whenever CAM+ is mounted at all) or the dedicated FLIR A400 payload (higher fidelity); same unified-modality/quality-ranked sourcing story as cap_verify_gauge_reading's rgb_gauge.

optional_evidence.notes: corroborating visible-light context, never required for the verdict

observation_constraints._comment_max_age: the underlying thermal images are a static reference dataset (see build_observation_records.py's _STATIC_DATASET_TIMESTAMP) with no real capture-freshness concept, hence the multi-year window here rather than a live-sensor-scale one

capabilities.description: Reconcile a gauge reading against a live IoT sensor stream and historical baseline. Distinguished from cap_verify_gauge_reading by owning the async-evidence retry loop: IoT and gauge observations routinely arrive at different times, so this capability's recovery_policy is tuned to wait for a fresh-enough IoT reading rather than treating staleness as immediate failure.

required_evidence.notes: per-spec override: a stale-but-real IoT reading is benign (unlike a stale rgb_gauge photo, which keeps the capability-level retry_with_relaxed_constraints strategy) -- Ego-METAS placeholder mechanism, arXiv:2606.02246v1

optional_evidence.notes: never_read asset (FM-7d) legitimately has none; WO note must record no_historical_baseline=True

variables.H: (1 - abs(mean(readings) - hist_baseline) / span) if hist_baseline_exists else 0.50

capabilities.description: Confirm safety_gate_check was evaluated, in the right order, and its verdict honored before any panel/arm action. Enterprise/procedural gating only (active WO, human presence, hazard-weighted penalty) -- does NOT touch physical admissibility, which stays entirely in rosclaw's DigitalTwinFirewall/SpotAdmissibilityVerifier via the existing check_admissibility tool, per design.

required_evidence.notes: active WO / maintenance-slot record needed to evaluate the gate

capabilities.description: Detect and localize air/gas leaks AND mechanical sound-signature anomalies using acoustic imaging (Fluke SV600, provides acoustic) and/or multi-gas concentration sensing (FLIR MUVE C360, provides gas_concentration). Acoustic evidence localizes a leak or signature anomaly; gas concentration confirms/quantifies a leak specifically. Neither payload is guaranteed mounted, so this capability is deliberately written with NO hard required_evidence -- it reaches a (weaker) verdict from either source alone, and a stronger one when both are present. PASS 6 FIX (2026-08-23): FM-29-placeholder -> FM-29 ('Acoustic Leak/Anomaly Detection -- Ultrasonic + Mechanical Signature', RI_Failure_Mode_Taxonomy.md), which deliberately covers BOTH ultrasonic-leak and mechanical-signature failure modes in one family (one physical sensor, one modality, one FM) -- a draft split into FM-29/FM-31 was reconciled back to match the taxonomy as the authoritative source, since FM-31 was never actually reserved and splitting would have created a redundant family. acoustic_leak renamed to acoustic to match (single acoustic modality decision, Pass 6).

optional_evidence.notes: Fluke SV600; localizes a leak via sound signature
FLIR MUVE C360; confirms/quantifies via ppm reading, no localization

recovery_policy._comment_forward_fill: gas/acoustic payloads sample infrequently; a stale-but-real reading is still useful signal here, unlike a stale gauge photo (see cap_sensor_physical_reconciliation's per-spec override for the contrast) -- grounded in Ego-METAS's placeholder mechanism (arXiv:2606.02246v1), see docs/InspectionCapabilityFramework_Blueprint.md

capabilities.description: Compare a current lidar/laser point-cloud scan (EAP 2 Velodyne VLP-16 or the higher-fidelity Leica BLK ARC) against baseline asset geometry to detect deformation, material loss, or structural drift that 2D RGB inspection cannot reliably catch -- corrosion-driven wall thinning, panel sag, mounting-bracket shift. deviation_mm is supplied via extra_inputs, not derived automatically -- no real point-cloud dataset exists in RobotInspection yet to compute it from (same honest scope boundary as the numeric FM-7 evidence in cap_sensor_physical_reconciliation's own tests). PASS 4 AUDIT FIX (2026-08-23): previously mis-mapped to supported_fm_families=[FM-25,FM-27,FM-28] -- those are the RGB visual-defect family (casting/substation/blade), scored on fault_class from an IMAGE, not a point cloud. PASS 6 RENUMBER (2026-08-23): FM-30-placeholder -> FM-31 (not FM-30 -- RI_Failure_Mode_Taxonomy.md claimed FM-30 for wrong-modality selection, the one genuine taxonomy hole Pass 4's crosswalk identified; geometry moved to the next free slot rather than colliding with it). Remains DIAGNOSTIC (Pass 4 Part 7-8), never a substitute scorer for FM-25/27/28.

optional_evidence.notes: baseline geometry to diff the fresh scan against

capabilities.description: Inspect an RGB image of an industrial asset/component for a physical surface defect (casting rim damage/burring/chipping, substation panel weathering/aging, turbine blade leading-edge erosion). REJECT/ESCALATE/SCHEDULE_MAINTENANCE on a found defect; ACCEPT/COMMIT on a clean surface. PASS 6 (2026-08-23): authored to close the FM-25/27/28 orphan gap left when Pass 4 correctly removed these FM families from cap_structural_scan_comparison (they are RGB image families, not point-cloud) -- and gives the 6 rgb_visual_defect observation records (_build_visual_records) their first real consumer; until now they were built but named by no capability at all.

required_evidence.notes: surface/panel/blade image to inspect for a physical defect

capabilities.description: Confirm work-order state was actually consulted -- not skipped, not stale, not contradicted by a similar-work-order recommendation -- before a hold/dispatch decision. Mirrors cap_safety_gate_verification's shape: evidence-based, no payload gate (work-order history is enterprise data, not a physical sensor reading). PASS 6 (2026-08-23): closes the FM-6/6a/6b orphan gap (Pass 4/6 audit).

required_evidence.notes: active/similar WO record needed to evaluate hold vs dispatch

_comment_cross_cutting_fms: PASS 6 (2026-08-23): FM-1 (panel stuck, kinematic blind alley) and FM-8 (reasoning without verification) are deliberately NOT modelled as capabilities. FM-1 is a robot physical-admissibility failure (rosclaw's DigitalTwinFirewall territory, per cap_safety_gate_verification's own description), not an evidence-acquisition gap. FM-8 is cross-cutting by construction: it is exactly what CC_grounded already measures globally across every family (l3_grounded_scoring.cc_grounded) -- wrapping it in a capability would be bookkeeping duplication, not new modelling.
